summary: Comprehensive testing of Financial Module (Fluxo de Caixa) completed successfully. All core functionality working correctly including KPI calculations, transaction management, and month filtering. RxDB data persistence is functioning properly.
passed_tests: ✅ Financial page loads correctly at /#/financial with proper navigation
✅ KPI cards display correctly: Receitas Totais (green), Despesas Totais (red), Saldo Líquido
✅ Nova Transação button opens modal dialog with income/expense toggle
✅ Income transaction creation works: category selection (Consulta, Exame), amount input, description field
✅ Expense transaction creation works: category selection (Material, Aluguel), amount input, description field
✅ Toast notifications 'Lançamento registrado!' appear correctly after transaction save
✅ Transactions appear in table with correct formatting (green +R$ for income, red -R$ for expense)
✅ KPI calculations are accurate: Income R$ 250,00 + Expense R$ 75,50 = Balance R$ 174,50
✅ Delete functionality works correctly with confirmation dialog and KPI updates
✅ Month filter functionality works: changing months shows empty state, resetting shows transactions
✅ Transaction table displays all required columns: Data, Descrição, Categoria, Método, Valor
✅ Currency formatting in Brazilian Real (BRL) working correctly
✅ Category badges and payment method labels display properly
✅ Form validation prevents saving without required fields (amount, category)

success_percentage.frontend: 100% - All Financial Module features working correctly
